title: Share typed gate validation and presentation for compact and full notes
outcome: Share typed gate validation and presentation for compact and full notes
acceptance: Inconsistent restored gate version or passed/failure fields refuse full-note reads even outside the terse tail; valid gates preserve all failure labels in full mode, compact bounds remain unchanged, and storage returns typed data rather than formatting user-facing gate summaries.

completion.summary: Shared domain gate validation and work-service compact/full formatter preserve the storage boundary; direct full reader rejects inconsistent restored gates.
